title: Nut Butter and Jelly Tortilla Pinwheels

steps.text: Place-Place 8-inch flour tortilla on cutting board
visible_evidence: Hand places a round flour tortilla on a cutting board
Flour tortilla lies flat on the cutting board

checks.text: The flour tortilla lies flat on the cutting board

steps.text: scoop-Use a butter knife to scoop nut butter from the jar
visible_evidence: Hand dips a butter knife into a nut butter jar
Nut butter coats the blade of the butter knife

checks.text: A butter knife is used to scoop nut butter from the jar

steps.text: Spread-Spread nut butter onto the tortilla, leaving 1/2-inch uncovered at the edges
visible_evidence: Butter knife spreads nut butter across the tortilla surface
Layer of nut butter covers the tortilla with a bare rim around the edge

checks.text: Nut butter is spread across the tortilla leaving an uncovered border about 1/2 inch wide around the edges

steps.text: Clean-Clean the knife by wiping it with a paper towel
visible_evidence: Hand wipes the butter knife blade with a paper towel
Knife blade appears clean of nut butter

checks.text: The butter knife blade is wiped clean with a paper towel

steps.text: scoop-Use the knife to scoop jelly from the jar
visible_evidence: Clean butter knife dips into a jelly jar
Jelly sits on the blade of the butter knife

checks.text: The butter knife scoops jelly from the jar

steps.text: Spread-Spread jelly over the nut butter
visible_evidence: Butter knife spreads jelly across the nut butter layer
Jelly layer covers the nut butter on the tortilla

checks.text: Jelly is spread evenly over the nut butter layer on the tortilla

steps.text: Clean-Clean the knife by wiping it with a paper towel
visible_evidence: Hand wipes the butter knife blade with a paper towel
Knife blade appears clean of jelly

checks.text: The butter knife blade is wiped clean with a paper towel

steps.text: Roll-Roll the tortilla from one end to the other into a log shape, about 1.5 inches thick. Roll it tight enough to prevent gaps, but not so tight that the filling leaks
visible_evidence: Hands roll the filled tortilla from one end to the other
Tortilla forms a compact cylindrical log about 1.5 inches thick

checks.text: The tortilla is rolled into a cylindrical log about 1.5 inches thick
The roll is tightly formed with filling contained inside the tortilla

steps.text: Secure-Secure the rolled tortilla by inserting 5 toothpicks about 1 inch apart
visible_evidence: Hands insert toothpicks vertically along the tortilla roll
Five toothpicks stand spaced along the length of the roll

checks.text: Toothpicks are inserted along the tortilla roll spaced about 1 inch apart

steps.text: Trim-Trim the ends of the tortilla roll with the butter knife, leaving 1/2 inch margin between the last toothpick and the end of the roll
visible_evidence: Butter knife slices off both ends of the tortilla roll
Trimmed roll ends have about a 1/2 inch margin past the outermost toothpicks

checks.text: The butter knife trims both ends of the tortilla roll leaving about a 1/2 inch margin from the outermost toothpicks

visible_evidence: Hand picks up the trimmed tortilla ends from the cutting board
Trimmed tortilla ends are removed from the work surface

checks.text: The trimmed tortilla ends are removed from the cutting board

steps.text: Slide-Slide floss under the tortilla, perpendicular to the length of the roll
visible_evidence: Hands hold dental floss taut and slide it beneath the tortilla roll
Floss lies under the roll perpendicular to its length

checks.text: The floss is positioned underneath the tortilla roll perpendicular to its length

steps.text: Place-Place the floss halfway between toothpicks
visible_evidence: Hands adjust the floss position beneath the tortilla roll
Floss aligns midway between two adjacent toothpicks

checks.text: The floss is centered halfway between two adjacent toothpicks

steps.text: Cross-Cross the floss's two ends over the tortilla roll's top
visible_evidence: Hands lift both ends of the floss up and cross them over the top of the roll
Floss loops around the tortilla roll with ends crossed on top

checks.text: Both ends of the floss are crossed over the top of the tortilla roll

steps.text: pull-pull the floss ends in opposite directions to slice
visible_evidence: Hands pull the crossed floss ends outward in opposite directions
Floss slices cleanly through the tortilla roll to separate a pinwheel

checks.text: The floss ends are pulled in opposite directions to cleanly slice through the tortilla roll

steps.text: slicing-Continue slicing with floss to create 1 more pinwheel
visible_evidence: Hands repeat the floss-slicing motion between another pair of toothpicks
An additional sliced pinwheel separates from the tortilla roll

checks.text: Floss is used to slice another pinwheel from the tortilla roll

steps.text: Place-Place the pinwheels on a plate
visible_evidence: Hands transfer the sliced tortilla pinwheels from the cutting board to a plate
Pinwheels sit arranged on a plate

checks.text: The sliced pinwheels are placed on a plate
